gates: Exact B/data/source roots, source commit and all 167 source-content pins, F0 split, registered data alias/stat identities, cache receipt/metadata and array stat-only identities, accepted dictionary artifact, parent checkpoint, profile receipts/run-directory proof, and all required accepted predecessor receipts are checked before OUTPUT.mkdir.
Campaign parent slice is checked for exact 200% CPU, 18/20 GB memory high/max, zero swap, required headroom, and an empty populated-cgroup scan.

Fixed selected GPU UUID and free-memory reserve are freshly queried. Existing GPU processes are observed for PID/UID/cgroup ownership; another campaign-owned process fails closed, foreign processes are preserved, and no empty-card requirement is imposed.
The exact physical research_tmp path is required on ext4 device 64512 matching the project device, with at least 25 GiB free.
Both private output/run paths are checked absent and the exact new AllThree systemd unit is checked not-found, then rechecked before create-only output staging.
fresh_gate_and_resource_review.submission: One direct systemd-run submission; no queue or automatic retry. Timeout/unknown outcomes are represented in durable submission metadata.

gate_findings: The local and embedded remote validators pin the original actual NLL launch-acceptance SHA separately from the actual terminal acceptance and exact-stop hashes.

The actual NLL terminal receipt binds run/unit/invocation, source commit, 167-file manifest, split, base representation and NLL objective; strict integer counters and native MainPID/ExecMainCode/ExecMainStatus 0/1/0; six epochs, selected epoch 5, 44,760 successful updates, 4,476 batches, zero skipped/nonfinite updates, and selected model_ep5 metadata.

The exact-stop receipt binds acceptance and invocation, requires the pre-stop native unit active/exited with MainPID 0 and code/status 1/0, empty populated snapshots, successful exact stop, and post-stop not-found/inactive/dead with MainPID 0 and empty invocation; the nested verifier is also exactly stopped.
NLL is only a sequential accepted-and-exact-stopped prerequisite. The AllThree argv initializer remains the parent @ep3 checkpoint; no NLL checkpoint is used for initialization.

nonblocking_inherited_text: The body retains the template module docstring calling itself an unbound template and some inherited diagnostic wording mentioning NLL. These are not executable guards or body-hash claims; actual AllThree run/unit/argv and receipt bindings are correct.

recipe_derivation.comparison: Static TRAINER_ARGV values in the rendered AllThree body versus the actual NLL launch body.

fixed_recipe.model: 467 inputs, two-layer hidden-256 GRU, one fixed 25-output mean/logvariance head
fixed_recipe.representation: ema_sparse; signed top-four-of-sixteen frozen dictionary code plus retained 112-wide residual, followed by causal signed innovation EMA half-life 32; not parameter EMA
fixed_recipe.schedule: seed 1001, seeded batch order, batch 16, chunk 2000, six epochs, fixed epoch 5, no evaluation, strict fp32; AdamW lr 1e-4/wd .01/beta2 .999, OneCycle warmup .05
fixed_recipe.target_and_cache: existing F0 split and homogeneous T3 cache; dictionary remains the accepted shared artifact

scope: Independent static source and small-receipt review of the exact rendered AllThree submission body before any B-side staging/admission. No body execution, B/SSH operation, or model/cache/data payload read.
